versos.grego: Διαμαρτύρομαι ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ, τοῦ μέλλοντος κρίνειν ζῶντας καὶ νεκρούς, καὶ τὴν ἐπιφάνειαν αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν βασιλείαν αὐτοῦ·

controles.web: I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his Kingdom:
controles.kjv: I charge thee therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;
controles.livre: Convoco-te diante de Deus e de Cristo Jesus, que irá julgar os vivos e os mortos, e pela sua aparição e seu reino:

versos.grego: κήρυξον τὸν λόγον, ἐπίστηθι εὐκαίρως ἀκαίρως, ἔλεγξον, ἐπιτίμησον, παρακάλεσον, ἐν πάσῃ μακροθυμίᾳ καὶ διδαχῇ.

controles.web: preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort, with all patience and teaching.
controles.kjv: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.
controles.livre: prega a palavra; insiste em tempo e fora de tempo; mostra os erros; repreende e exorta, com toda paciência e ensino.

versos.grego: ἔσται γὰρ καιρὸς ὅτε τῆς ὑγιαινούσης διδασκαλίας οὐκ ἀνέξονται, ἀλλὰ κατὰ τὰς ἰδίας ἐπιθυμίας ἑαυτοῖς ἐπισωρεύσουσιν διδασκάλους κνηθόμενοι τὴν ἀκοήν,

controles.web: For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but, having itching ears, will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts;
controles.kjv: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;
controles.livre: Pois virá tempo em que não suportarão a sã doutrina; em vez disso, terão comichão no ouvido e amontoarão para si instrutores conforme os seus próprios desejos maus;

versos.grego: καὶ ἀπὸ μὲν τῆς ἀληθείας τὴν ἀκοὴν ἀποστρέψουσιν, ἐπὶ δὲ τοὺς μύθους ἐκτραπήσονται.

controles.web: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn aside to fables.
controles.kjv: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.
controles.livre: desviarão os ouvidos da verdade, e se voltarão aos mitos.

versos.grego: σὺ δὲ νῆφε ἐν πᾶσιν, κακοπάθησον, ἔργον ποίησον εὐαγγελιστοῦ, τὴν διακονίαν σου πληροφόρησον.

controles.web: But you be sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill your ministry.
controles.kjv: But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry.
controles.livre: Tu, porém, vigia-te em todas as coisas; suporta as aflições, faz a obra de evangelista, cumpre o teu serviço.

versos.grego: Ἐγὼ γὰρ ἤδη σπένδομαι, καὶ ὁ καιρὸς τῆς ἀναλύσεώς μου ἐφέστηκεν.

controles.web: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.
controles.kjv: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.
controles.livre: Pois já sou uma oferta de derramamento, e o tempo da minha partida está perto.

versos.grego: τὸν καλὸν ἀγῶνα ἠγώνισμαι, τὸν δρόμον τετέλεκα, τὴν πίστιν τετήρηκα·

controles.web: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.
controles.kjv: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
controles.livre: Lutei a boa luta, terminei a carreira, guardei a fé.

versos.grego: λοιπὸν ἀπόκειταί μοι ὁ τῆς δικαιοσύνης στέφανος, ὃν ἀποδώσει μοι ὁ κύριος ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ, ὁ δίκαιος κριτής, οὐ μόνον δὲ ἐμοὶ ἀλλὰ καὶ πᾶσι τοῖς ἠγαπηκόσι τὴν ἐπιφάνειαν αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: From now on, there is stored up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.
controles.kjv: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.
controles.livre: Desde agora a coroa da justiça me está reservada, a qual o Senhor, o justo Juiz, me dará naquele dia; e não somente a mim, mas também a todos os que amarem a sua vinda.

versos.grego: Σπούδασον ἐλθεῖν πρός με ταχέως·

controles.web: Be diligent to come to me soon,
controles.kjv: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me:
controles.livre: Procura vir logo até mim,

versos.grego: Δημᾶς γάρ με ἐγκατέλιπεν ἀγαπήσας τὸν νῦν αἰῶνα, καὶ ἐπορεύθη εἰς Θεσσαλονίκην, Κρήσκης εἰς Γαλατίαν, Τίτος εἰς Δαλματίαν·

controles.web: for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, and Titus to Dalmatia.
controles.kjv: For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.
controles.livre: porque Demas me desamparou: ele amou o tempo presente, e partiu para Tessalônica; Crescente para a Galácia, e Tito para a Dalmácia.

versos.grego: Λουκᾶς ἐστιν μόνος μετ’ ἐμοῦ. Μᾶρκον ἀναλαβὼν ἄγε μετὰ σεαυτοῦ· ἔστιν γάρ μοι εὔχρηστος εἰς διακονίαν.

controles.web: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.
controles.kjv: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.
controles.livre: Só Lucas está comigo. Toma Marcos, e o traz contigo, porque ele me é muito útil para o serviço.

versos.grego: Τυχικὸν δὲ ἀπέστειλα εἰς Ἔφεσον.

controles.web: But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
controles.kjv: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.
controles.livre: Enviei Tíquico a Éfeso.

versos.grego: τὸν φελόνην, ὃν ἀπέλιπον ἐν Τρῳάδι παρὰ Κάρπῳ, ἐρχόμενος φέρε, καὶ τὰ βιβλία, μάλιστα τὰς μεμβράνας.

controles.web: Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come, and the books, especially the parchments.
controles.kjv: The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring with thee, and the books, but especially the parchments.
controles.livre: Quando vieres, traz a capa que deixei em Trôade na casa de Carpo, e os livros, principalmente os pergaminhos.

versos.grego: Ἀλέξανδρος ὁ χαλκεὺς πολλά μοι κακὰ ἐνεδείξατο· ἀποδώσει αὐτῷ ὁ Κύριος κατὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ·

controles.web: Alexander, the coppersmith, did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his works,
controles.kjv: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:
controles.livre: Alexandre, o que trabalha com cobre, me causou muitos males; o Senhor retribuirá a ele conforme suas obras.

versos.grego: ὃν καὶ σὺ φυλάσσου· λίαν γὰρ ἀντέστη τοῖς ἡμετέροις λόγοις.

controles.web: of whom you also must beware; for he greatly opposed our words.
controles.kjv: Of whom be thou ware also; for he hath greatly withstood our words.
controles.livre: Toma cuidado com ele também, porque ele se opôs muito às nossas palavras.

versos.grego: Ἐν τῇ πρώτῃ μου ἀπολογίᾳ οὐδείς μοι παρεγένετο, ἀλλὰ πάντες με ἐγκατέλιπον· μὴ αὐτοῖς λογισθείη·

controles.web: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.
controles.kjv: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge.
controles.livre: Na minha primeira defesa ninguém esteve comigo para me ajudar, pelo contrário, todos me desampararam. Que isso não seja levado em consideração contra eles.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Κύριός μοι παρέστη καὶ ἐνεδυνάμωσέν με, ἵνα δι’ ἐμοῦ τὸ κήρυγμα πληροφορηθῇ καὶ ἀκούσωσιν πάντα τὰ ἔθνη, καὶ ἐρύσθην ἐκ στόματος λέοντος.

controles.web: But the Lord stood by me, and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear; and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
controles.kjv: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
controles.livre: Mas o Senhor me ajudou e me fortaleceu, a fim de que por mim a pregação fosse completamente divulgada, e todos os gentios a ouvissem; e fui livrado da boca do leão.

versos.grego: ῥύσεταί με ὁ Κύριος ἀπὸ παντὸς ἔργου πονηροῦ καὶ σώσει εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν αὐτοῦ τὴν ἐπουράνιον· ᾧ ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων, ἀμήν.

controles.web: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom; to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
controles.kjv: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
controles.livre: O Senhor me livrará de toda obra má, e me preservará para o seu reino celestial. A ele seja glória para todo o sempre. Amém.

versos.grego: Ἄσπασαι Πρίσκαν καὶ Ἀκύλαν καὶ τὸν Ὀνησιφόρου οἶκον.

controles.web: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.
controles.kjv: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.
controles.livre: Cumprimenta Prisca e Áquila, e a casa de Onesíforo.

versos.grego: Ἔραστος ἔμεινεν ἐν Κορίνθῳ, Τρόφιμον δὲ ἀπέλιπον ἐν Μιλήτῳ ἀσθενοῦντα.

controles.web: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.
controles.kjv: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.
controles.livre: Erasto ficou em Corinto, e deixei Trófimo doente em Mileto.

versos.grego: Σπούδασον πρὸ χειμῶνος ἐλθεῖν. Ἀσπάζεταί σε Εὔβουλος καὶ Πούδης καὶ Λίνος καὶ Κλαυδία καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ πάντες.

controles.web: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.
controles.kjv: Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.
controles.livre: Procura vir antes do inverno. Êubulo, Pudente, Lino, Cláudia e todos os irmãos te cumprimentam.

versos.grego: Ὁ Κύριος μετὰ τοῦ πνεύματός σου. ἡ χάρις μεθ’ ὑμῶν.

controles.web: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
controles.kjv: The Lord Jesus Christ be with thy spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.  The second epistle unto Timotheus, ordained the first bishop of the church of the Ephesians, was written from Rome, when Paul was brought before Nero the second time.
controles.livre: O Senhor seja com o teu espírito. A graça seja convosco.
